svg.aria-label: Inside the Mnemos-DNA mixer: the shared 32x32 KDA recurrent state and the 65,536 per-8-mer 16x16 fast-weight matrices, with the gated write and read equations; and the Mnemos-DNA-C training-length curriculum.
svg.text: a · inside the mixer: two memories, read in parallel from the same q, k, v
1 · KDA recurrent state — one matrix for the whole sequence
the delta rule writes v while erasing what S predicts.
O(1) memory — but one shared matrix, so every new
8-mer competes for the same fixed capacity.
2 · per-8-mer fast weights — one matrix per address
The two memories differ in kind,
S — one matrix, shared by every
b · Mnemos-DNA-C training-length curriculum (Mnemos-DNA trains at a fixed 131K throughout)
1K → 131K warmup over the first 10% of steps
then a fixed per-step mix — tokens/step stays 131,072, so the token budget and LR schedule match Mnemos-DNA exactly
